'''Florica Topârceanu''' (born June 14, 1954) is an [[Antarctic]] researcher, best known for her work was on Antarctic aquatic viruses and the development of the Antarctic scientific community in [[Romania]]. She was the first Romanian woman biologist to study life in Antarctica<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://www.scar.org/scar_media/documents/news/newsletters/SCARnewsletter35_Dec2013.pdf|title=SCAR newsletter|last=|first=|date=2013|website=scar.org|publisher=Scientific Committee on Antarctic Research|access-date=}}{{Dead link|date=April 2024 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> and the first Romanian woman expert to the [[Antarctic Treaty System|Antarctic Treaty]].

==Early life and education==
Florica Topârceanu was born on June 14, 1954, in [[Bucharest]], Romania. She attended the [[University of Bucharest]] and studied biology with a specialisation in biochemistry from 1973 to 1977, and continued to obtain an MSc in 1978. During the next twenty years she worked in the Ștefan S. Nicolau Institute of Virology at the [[Romanian Academy]] in the departments of Viral Molecular Biology (1983–1990), Viral Immunochemistry (1990–1993), Virosis Ethiopatology (1994–1999), Viral Genetic Engineering (2000–2004), National Center of Reference for Influenza and Respiratory Viroses (1992–2004), Anti-viral Therapy (2004–2009). She was awarded a PhD in biochemistry by the University of Bucharest in 1999.

==Career and impact==
Topârceanu's research interests are Antarctic aquatic viruses and her research expertise focuses on the life sciences, people and the biosphere. She is a founding member and the Scientific Secretary of the National Commission on Antarctic Research (NCAR) of Romania,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.academiaromana.ro/comisiiAR/Comisia-CNCA/comisii_CNCA_cnt.htm|title=Contacts|last=|first=|website=academiaromana.ro|publisher=Comisia Naţională pentru Cercetări Antarctice|access-date=2016-06-12}}</ref> as well as being the head of the Extreme Life Laboratory at the Virology Institute 'Ștefan Nicolau' of the Romanian Academy.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.virology.ro/en/departments/antiviral-therapy/research-team.html|title=Department of Cellular and Molecular Pathology Research team|website=virology.ro|publisher=Nicolau Institute of Virology|access-date=2016-06-12|archive-date=2016-05-21|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160521153417/http://www.virology.ro/en/departments/antiviral-therapy/research-team.html|url-status=dead}}</ref> Topârceanu is one of the initiators of an Arctic and Antarctic Research Department within the Romanian Institute for Biological Sciences (INCDSB).<ref>{{Citation|last=Letsoc|first=Suiram|title=First national symposium on polar scientific research|date=2012-03-25|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6JU9Gxx2Y9w|access-date=2016-06-12}}</ref>

[[File:COMNAP Larsemann Hills map 2012.png|thumb|Map showing the [[Law-Racoviță-Negoiță Station|Law-Racoviță Station]] on Antarctica's [[Larsemann Hills]]]]
Topârceanu was the primary biological scientist to the First Romanian National Antarctica Expedition (ENROCA 1) in the Austral summer of 2005–2006 and was present at the inauguration of the [[Law-Racoviță-Negoiță Station|Law-Racoviță Station]] (Australia&ndash;Romania) in the [[Larsemann Hills]] of [[East Antarctica]], on February 20, 2006.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://actamicrobio.bg/amb311.pdf|title=Acta Microbiologica Bulgarica|last=|first=|date=2015|website=actamicrobio.bg|publisher=Bulgarian Society for Microbiology|access-date=}}</ref> The three members of the expedition&mdash;[[Teodor Negoiță]], Topârceanu, and Elena Bocanciu&mdash;arrived in Antarctica on January 13, 2006 and stayed there for 44 days. Preparations for the expedition had been done in the harsh wintry climate of the [[Bucegi Mountains]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://adevarul.ro/stiri-locale/constanta/aventura-unui-explorator-roman-la-polul-sud-cum-1785086.html|title=Aventura unui explorator român la Polul Sud: cum ar putea România să obțină din nou dreptul de a folosi baza Law-Racoviță din Antarctica|language=ro|trans-title=The adventure of a Romanian explorer at the South Pole: how Romania could regain the right to use the Law-Racoviță base in Antarctica|newspaper=[[Adevărul]]|first=Mariana|last=Iancu|date=May 16, 2017|access-date=March 4, 2023}}</ref> Topârceanu was, after [[Emil Racoviță]] (a member of the [[Belgian Antarctic Expedition|Belgica Antarctic Expedition]] in 1897), the first Romanian biologist,<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.bibmet.ro/detalii-eveniment.aspx?evId=1664&catId=33&c=1|title=Reprezentări românești în Antarctica|date=2014|website=bibmet.ro|publisher=Biblioteca Metropolitană București|trans-title=Romanian representation in Antarctica|access-date=2016-06-12}}</ref> as well as the first Romanian woman biologist to study life in Antarctica<ref name=":0" /> and the first Romanian woman expert to the Antarctic Treaty.

She was the coordinator of CEEX Module 3: Structuring of an integrated international cooperation research on biodiversity in polar ecosystems, the response to environmental changes, and applications,<ref name=":3">{{Cite web|url=https://www.acad.ro/comisiiAR/Comisia-CNCA/doc2013/d0905-ActivitatiMembriiCNCA.doc|title=Sub coordonarea Academiei Române|last=|first=|date=2013|website=acad.ro|publisher=Comisia Națională pentru Cercetări Antarctice|access-date=}}</ref> and other projects within the [[International Polar Year]] (IPY). She is the current director of the Romanian Antarctic project on biomedical research under extreme life conditions (Promotion Within a European and International Partnership of Biomedical Research under Extreme Life Conditions), an international collaboration between universities from Austria, Australia, Belgium, Bulgaria, China, Israel, Sweden, and the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.virology.ro/en/departments/antiviral-therapy/projects.html#proj7|title=Department of Antiviral Therapy – Projects|website=virology.ro|publisher=Nicolau Institute of Virology|access-date=2016-06-13|archive-date=2016-08-14|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160814101007/http://www.virology.ro/en/departments/antiviral-therapy/projects.html#proj7|url-status=dead}}</ref> Topârceanu collaborated on the IPY Project 1267 "Evolution of pedobiological processes in Polar Zones", and achieved the project "Adaptation responses of Romanian explorers to the extreme Antarctic environment as compared with the Arctic one" in cooperation with Australia, as proposed within IPY Action 181 "''Taking the Antarctic – Arctic Polar Pulse''".<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.uam.es/otros/cn-scar/4th_SCAR_Open_Science/pdf/osc2010768.pdf|title=Experimental model using polar expeditioners teams for the study of biometeorological adaptation in a changing climate|last=Topârceanu|first=Florica|last2=Negoiță|first2=Teodor Gheorghe |author2-link=Teodor Negoiță|year=2010|website=www.uam.es|publisher=4th SCAR Open Science|access-date=}}</ref> She has visited and worked at the Chinese Antarctic station of "Zhong Shan",<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=http://memorandum.ro/statia-law-racovita-negoita-din-antarctica-un-vis-implinit-in-lumea-aisbergurilor/|title=Stația Law-Racoviță-Negoiță din Antarctica: Un vis împlinit în lumea aisbergurilor|date=2015|website=memorandum.ro|publisher=Revista de Educatie Politica|language=|trans-title=Law-Racoviță-Negoiță station in Antarctica: A dream come true in the world of icebergs|access-date=2016-06-12}}</ref><ref>{{Citation|last=Suiram Letsoc|title=Science on ice. With Chinese people in Antarctica|date=2005|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zL0rm9SCu5s|publisher=polar-institute.ro|access-date=2016-06-12}}</ref> the Russian station of "Progress II"<ref name=":1" /> and the Australian "Davis" station.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://radioiasi.ro/emisiuni/invitatul-editiei-doctor-florica-toparceanu-primul-biolog-roman-dupa-emil-racovita-care-a-ajuns-in-antarctica-orizont-deschis-cu-horia-daraban-5-04-2015/|title=Invitatul ediției: doctor Florica Topârceanu, primul biolog român, după Emil Racoviță, care a ajuns în Antarctica – Orizont Deschis cu Horia Daraban|date=2015-04-05|website=radioiasi.ro|publisher=Radio Iași|trans-title=Dr Florica Topârceanu first Romanian biologist, after Emil Racoviță, who arrived in Antarctica|access-date=2016-06-12}}</ref>

She holds a central role in the National Commission for Antarctic Research (NCAR) of the Romanian Academy of Bucharest (Romania) and is the current Scientific Secretary of the Executive Bureau of NCAR.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.academiaromana.ro/comisiiAR/Comisia-CNCA/comisii_CNCA_cnt.htm|title=CNCA – Contact|last=Romana|first=Academia|website=www.academiaromana.ro|access-date=2016-06-12}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://canberra.mae.ro/en/local-news/797|title=Celebrating 8 years since the inauguration of Law – Racoviță – Negoiță Scientific Research Station in Antarctica|publisher= Embassy of Romania to the Commonwealth of Australia|website=canberra.mae.ro|access-date=2016-06-12}}</ref> She is the current Chief Officer<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.medicalantarctica.com/#!contact-details-romania/cy3z|title=MedicalAntarctica|website=www.medicalantarctica.com|access-date=2016-06-12}}</ref> and Romanian contact point,<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|url=https://www.academiaromana.ro/comisiiAR/Comisia-CNCA/doc2015/d0107-Circulara02.pdf|title=Circulara 2|last=|first=|date=2015|website=|publisher=Comisia Naţională pentru Cercetări Antarctice|access-date=}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.medicalantarctica.com/#!contact-details-romania/cy3z|title=Contact|website=medicalantarctica.com|publisher=Medical Antarctica|access-date=2016-06-14}}</ref> of the NCAR Human Biology and Medicine (EGHBM) expert group, a joint programme with [[Scientific Committee on Antarctic Research|SCAR]] and SCAR-COMNAP and is the main Romanian delegate to [[Scientific Committee on Antarctic Research|SCAR]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.scar.org/members-and-officers/delegates|title=Delegates|last=|first=|website=scar.org|publisher=Scientific Committee on Antarctic Research|access-date=2016-06-12}}</ref> Topârceanu has also served as an [[Association of Polar Early Career Scientists|APECS]] Mentor. Topârceanu was the delegate at the Antarctic Treaty Consultative Meeting (ATCM) in 2005, 2006, and 2013 and is the Romanian representative to ATCM for scientific and operational.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.ats.aq/devAS/ats_meetings_contacts.aspx?lang=e|title=Antarctic Treaty Consultative Meeting Contact Points|website=www.ats.aq|publisher=Secretariat of the Antarctic treaty|access-date=2016-06-12|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170510091813/http://www.ats.aq/devAS/ats_meetings_contacts.aspx?lang=e|archive-date=2017-05-10|url-status=dead}}</ref> She was also the Romanian invited delegate of NCAR to the Council of Managers of National Antarctic Programmes (COMNAP) AGM 2015.<ref name=":2" />

Topârceanu was instrumental to Romania being accepted as an Associated Member State to SCAR in 2008 by consulting on documents related to NCAR establishment (Statute, Rules of Procedures, Organization),<ref name=":3" /> contributing to the Romanian Antarctic Science Strategic Plan (2013–2020) to develop the [[National Antarctic Program]] under the Laws of Antarctic Treaty and Madrid Protocol,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.acad.ro/comisiiAR/Comisia-CNCA/doc2013/PlanStrategic_CNCA_2013_MEN.doc|title=Plan Strategic pentru Cercetările Antarctice|last=|first=|date=2013|website=acad.ro|publisher=Academia Română|trans-title=Strategic Plan for Antarctic research|access-date=}}</ref> and her role in Antarctic theme projects.<ref name=":3" /> Her work has provided insight into human adaptations to extreme conditions and continues to promote the domestic and international cooperation in polar research fields<ref name=":3" /> in order to develop the Romanian Antarctic community. Topârceanu has spoken on "Conducting scientific research in the field in Antarctica in accordance with the Environmental Code of Conduct issued by SCAR", at the Environment and Climate Change Ministry in 2013.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://biodiversitate.mmediu.ro/stories/ziua-internationala-antarcticii|title=Ziua internațională a Antarcticii|date=2013|website=biodiversitate.mmediu.ro|publisher=Mecanismul de Schimb de Informaţii pentru Biodiversitate|trans-title=International Day of Antarctica|access-date=2016-06-12}}</ref>

Topârceanu has been active in Antarctic  outreach including being interviewed for Romanian national radio<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.radioromaniacultural.ro/pages/view/40748|title=Evenimentele Bibliotecii Metropolitane București|last=|first=|date=2015|website=www.radioromaniacultural.ro|publisher=[[Romanian Radio Broadcasting Company]]|trans-title=Events in the Metropolitan Library Bucharest|access-date=2016-06-12}}</ref> as well as photographic exhibitions.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.avantaje.ro/articol/o-romanca-la-polul-sud-569237|title=O romanca la Polul Sud|date=2007|website=www.avantaje.ro|publisher=Avantaje|trans-title=A Romanian woman from South Pole|access-date=2016-06-12}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://memorandum.ro/statia-law-racovita-din-antarctica-9-ani-de-la-deschidere-de-catre-dr-ing-teodor-gheorghe-negoita-13-ianuarie-2006-2015/|title=Stația Law-Racoviță din Antarctica – 9 ani de la deschidere|date=2015|website=memorandum.ro|publisher=Revista de Educație Politica|language=|trans-title=Stația Law-Racoviță din Antarctica – 9 ani de la deschidere|access-date=2016-06-12|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150203053247/http://memorandum.ro/statia-law-racovita-din-antarctica-9-ani-de-la-deschidere-de-catre-dr-ing-teodor-gheorghe-negoita-13-ianuarie-2006-2015/|archive-date=2015-02-03|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://salvamont.org/main/articole/blog_en_id_1672_userid_0.html|title=Primul experiment Românesc de evaluare a modificărilor metabolice și imune ale organismului uman la temperaturi scăzute|last=|first=|date=2005|website=salvamont.org|publisher=Salvamont|trans-title=First experiment Romanian and metabolic changes assessment of human body immune to low temperatures|access-date=2016-06-12}}</ref>

==Awards and honors==
Topârceanu's invention "''Considerations on possible cerulloplasmin functions in the infection with influenza and para-influenza viruses''" won second prize.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.unboundmedicine.com/medline/citation/3029949/Considerations_about_the_possible_function_of_ceruloplasmin_in_influenza_and_parainfluenza_virus_infections_|title=Considerations about the possible function of ceruloplasmin in influenza and parainfluenza virus infection|date=1986|website=www.unboundmedicine.com|publisher=Virologie|access-date=2016-06-12}}</ref> She received a plate of honour – "''You offered us a life lesson''", from the broadcast team of the national "Romantica" TV Station ("9409 – Romantica") on September 20, 2008.
